title: introduce-compact-connector-telemetry-and-unified-retry-dsl-across-py-ts-go
author: Sofia Nguyen
description:
Motivation: Multiple SDKs had divergent retry semantics and fragmented telemetry hooks which made cross-language integrations and debugging harder for customers running mixed deployments. This PR consolidates a compact connector surface, introduces a small declarative retry DSL for common retry strategies, and enriches streaming telemetry (span tags + token-level counters) across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs.

What changed (high level):
- Introduced a compact connector abstraction that normalizes credential lookup and heartbeat hints; implementations in py/ts/go delegate to language idiomatic factories.
- Added a declarative retry DSL (RetryPreset) supporting: no-retry, idempotent-only, hedged-read, and latency-aware backoff. Presets are documented and serializable in SDK telemetry.
- Streaming adapters: added a lightweight stream-metadata envelope with per-chunk metrics (latency, chunk-size, credentials-state) and optional span annotations.
- Telemetry: emit connector_id, retry_preset, and session_warmup flags as consistent tags across SDK spans/traces.
- Version bumps: python -> 1.20.0, typescript -> 1.37.0, go -> 1.9.0.
- Docs: added cross-SDK migration guide and examples for combining RetryPreset with stream handlers and connector factories.

Checklist: [x] Unit tests for RetryPreset behaviors (py/ts/go) 
[x] Integration smoke in CI with a local runtime stub 
[x] Docs and changelog entries 
[x] Backward-compatibility notes (see release_notes)

Compatibility and migration notes: The compact connector is additive and uses adapter shims when older connector factory signatures are detected. Default retry behavior remains unchanged unless callers opt into RetryPreset. Streaming envelope adds an optional header field; servers ignore unknown fields so no rollout coordination is required.

Related: ENG-4123 (retry policy harmonization), ENG-4219 (stream telemetry parity).
